description: Total production Units for Self-Consumption - Monthly is a dataset listed in E-REDES open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity distribution operator, published or maintained by E-REDES (Portugal). This dataset presents the number of certified Self-Consumption Production Units (UPACs) connected to the E-REDES-operated grid and holding an active contract on the last day of the month under analysis. The data are organized by geographical location (district, municipality, parish, and postal code), installed capacity range, total installed capacity, voltage level, and technology type. Coverage: Portugal. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Renewables. The portal shows 2026-09-16 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eredes-open-data-portal.
